generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Financial bids of the technically qualified bidders only will be opened
Right of acceptance or rejection of any or all tenders with or without any reasons is reserved with the undersigned or any concerned higher officers of the Department
Conditional tender will not be Considered
Tender processing amount will not be refundable
Contractors should have to upload the scan copy of all necessary qualification documents, and submit the original documents certificates while tender opening evaluation for verification
The Photos and Video graphs should be taken before commencement, during execution and after completion of the work in presence of nodal officers
The liquidated damage for whole of the works are Rs. 0.10 percent per day the maximum amount of liquidated damages for the whole of works is 10 percent of final contract price
The agency shall furnish affidavit stating that existing commitments furnished by him are true. If found false action shall be taken as per law

The bidder shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of each tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The department is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD 300 LET 2006 Bangalore Dated 01/01/2007 and Government Letter No.PW 134 BMS 2007 Dated 27/7/2007 a sum amounting to 1 percent of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund

The Item Rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per the prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading, with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of all machineries and equipments and all incidental charges etc complete necessary for completion of work. All the Items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work
The field laboratory shall preferably locate, adjacent to the site with the required amenity as per the clause
Self declaration of machineries are not accepted
The work should be completed within the stipulated period from the date of agreement and The date of agreement itself is the date of commencement of the work
Third party inspection is mandatory for all the works in this programme

The Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed form from the competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (District Level Officer) and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Certificate / Certificates shall be produced whenever required
Executive Engineer has authority to accept or reject any tender without assigning reason
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc., decision of Executive Engineer is final
The bidder must submit 5 years Profit and loss account obtained from Chartered Accountant (CA) Only

The Furnished E.M.D. will be released only after successfully execution of the Tender Agreement by the successful Tenderer or bid validity days from the date of submission of Tender whichever is earlier
Before tendering for the works the tenderer may inspect the site personally
The successful tenderer shall maintain the work during the defect liability period of 365 Days from the date of completion of the work
The Tenderer shall have valid KPWD license
Other details and instructions shall be seen and fallowed as per the bidding documents KW
The Road / Building constructed under this programme shall be of high standard

Bidders should upload only prescribed documents for this work. If Unnecessary documents uploaded by the bidder then tender will be directly rejected and further correspondence will not be entertained declaration should be uploaded on bidders letter head duly signed
The work should be completed as per detail notification attached

All Rates included with all lead, lifts, loading and unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments incidental Charges, etc., complete. and as per specification and directions of the Engineer incharge of the work

Qualification and experience of the key technical and Management personnel in permanent employment with the Tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this work if work is awarded Graduate / Diploma Engineer Civil 1 Nos. & Literate Assistant Any Degree Passed 1 Nos
All Terms and Conditions as per Bid Document
Incorrect Bid Capacity submitted by the Bidder will not be considered and the bid will be rejected
Bidders should upload only prescribed documents for this work if unnecessary documents uploaded then bid will be directly rejected
Profit and Loss Account / Audit Report Last 5 Year
Latest Income Tax

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: 1.The Tenderer shall have valid class IV and above KPWD Licence

2.To qualify for award of this contract, Each tenderer in its name should have in the last five year 2021-22 to 2025-26 Achieved in at least TWO FINANCIAL years annual turnover not less than amount put to tender attach certificated from CA on Letter Head in all classes of civil engineering construction works only with UDIN No. otherwise bid will be directly Disqualified or Rejected

3.To qualify for award of this contract, Each tenderer in his name should have in the last five year i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed, as prime contractor, at least One Similar Nature of work of value not less than 50 percent of work on amount put to tender attach certificate by not below rank of Executive Engineer with Indent No from e-Procurement Portal
4.Annexure1 As per Attached Bid document should be given on Rs.100/- Stamp Paper with notary
5.Accurate Bid Capacity on Bidder Letter Head

6.As prescribed format of KW Tender Bid Document bidder should give work in Hand and Tender Submitted Details in all Department along with Indent No. It not submitted the details bids will be rejected without any intimation
